title: Heated core in a rigid sleeve: axisymmetric thermoelastic hoop stress (analytic)
description:
Axisymmetric (r, z) elastic_waves: a long aluminium-like cylinder (radius a = 4.8 mm, 48 cells of 0.1 mm; x = r, the axis is x_lo) in a rigid frictionless sleeve (bc_x_hi rigid: u_r = 0, s_rz = 0 at r = a), periodic along z (4 cells: a long cylinder, e_zz = 0). A short heating pulse (heat_pulse_source, Grueneisen G = 2, absorbed H = 5e5 J/m^3) in the core r < b = a / 2 adds the thermoelastic stress -sigma* = -G H to s_rr, s_zz and s_tt there; mass-proportional damping (acoustic_damping = 2 omega_1, the lowest radial mode critically damped) lets the ringing die out, so after 4 us (~400 steps, < 1 s) the fields are the static plane-strain thermal stress.
Analytic (Lame, plane strain, beta = b^2 / a^2): core u_r = A r, s_rr = s_tt = sigma* ((lambda + mu)(1 - beta) / (lambda + 2 mu) - 1), s_zz = sigma* (lambda (1 - beta) / (lambda + 2 mu) - 1); sleeve side u_r = B (r - a^2 / r), s_rr = -sigma* beta (lambda + mu + mu a^2 / r^2) / (lambda + 2 mu), s_tt = -sigma* beta (lambda + mu - mu a^2 / r^2) / (lambda + 2 mu), s_zz = -sigma* beta lambda / (lambda + 2 mu). The hoop stress jumps from -0.42 sigma* (compression) in the core to +0.03 sigma* (tension) just outside it. On the staggered ring-volume grid this static solution is exact with r^2 -> r_c^2 - dx^2 / 4 in the cell stresses (u_r = B (R - a^2 / R) on the faces satisfies every discrete face equilibrium), which the references use; expected agreement ~1e-5 (float32, residual ringing ~1e-7).
Derived values tab: stt_core_mean / srr_core_mean / szz_core_mean = ring-weighted means over the core vs the core values; stt_probe_end / srr_outer_end = last samples of the stt probe in the core and the sxx probe at r = 36.5 dx; tolerance 1e-3.
Line profile tab (final state, along r at mid-height): stt_radial, srr_radial, szz_radial vs the Lame profiles; tolerance 1e-3 of the range.
Probes tab: hoop_probe and radial_probe settle on the dashed static values after the damped ringing.

parameters.name: rho_al
parameters.description: density in kg/m^3 (aluminium-like)

parameters.name: cL_al
parameters.description: longitudinal speed in m/s

parameters.name: cS_al
parameters.description: shear speed in m/s

parameters.name: mu_al
parameters.description: shear modulus mu in Pa (24.95 GPa)

parameters.name: M_al
parameters.description: P-wave modulus lambda + 2 mu in Pa (111.3 GPa)

parameters.name: lam_al
parameters.description: Lame lambda in Pa (61.4 GPa)

parameters.name: G_th
parameters.description: Grueneisen parameter: thermoelastic stress per absorbed energy density

parameters.name: H_abs
parameters.description: absorbed energy density of the whole pulse in J/m^3

parameters.name: w_p
parameters.description: heating pulse 1/e half-width in s

parameters.name: d_p
parameters.description: heating pulse centre time in s

parameters.name: q0
parameters.description: peak heating power density in W/m^3 (2.8e12)

parameters.name: sig_star
parameters.description: thermoelastic stress G H in Pa (1 MPa; the envelope integral from t = 0)

parameters.name: dx_cell
parameters.description: uniform cell size

parameters.name: N_r
parameters.description: cells along r

parameters.name: a_cyl
parameters.description: cylinder (sleeve) radius

parameters.name: b_core
parameters.description: heated core radius (a cell edge)

parameters.name: beta
parameters.description: core area fraction b^2 / a^2

parameters.name: H_z
parameters.description: periodic z period (z-uniform fields)

parameters.name: y_mid
parameters.description: height of the probes and the radial lines (a cell centre)

parameters.name: r_core_probe
parameters.description: radius of the hoop-stress probe (core cell centre)

parameters.name: r_outer_probe
parameters.description: radius of the radial-stress probe (cell centre outside the core)

parameters.name: f_r1
parameters.description: lowest radial (breathing) mode with u_r(a) = 0 in Hz (816 kHz)

parameters.name: g_damp
parameters.description: mass-proportional damping rate 2 omega_1 in 1/s (mode 1 critically damped)

parameters.name: T_run
parameters.description: study duration (ringing below 1e-7 of sigma*)

parameters.name: s_core
parameters.description: core s_rr = s_tt in Pa (-0.42 MPa)

parameters.name: szz_core
parameters.description: core s_zz in Pa (-0.59 MPa)

parameters.name: srr_outer
parameters.description: s_rr at the outer probe cell in Pa (discrete-exact r^2 -> r_c^2 - dx^2/4)

analytic_curves.name: stt_radial
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < b_core, s_core, -sig_star*beta*(lam_al + mu_al - mu_al*a_cyl**2/(x**2 - dx_cell**2/4))/(lam_al + 2*mu_al))

analytic_curves.name: srr_radial
analytic_curves.expression: where(x < b_core, s_core, -sig_star*beta*(lam_al + mu_al + mu_al*a_cyl**2/(x**2 - dx_cell**2/4))/(lam_al + 2*mu_al))
